reviews.review:
First off, respect for putting your work into the world, that’s not EASY at all!

I’m writing this because I KNOW YOU CAN DO BETTER!!

I played this game for 3.6 hours with my community, and honestly, it feels no different from the demo at ALL!
To ask people to pay for something like this is UNACCEPTABLE. I’m not refunding it because
I BELIEVE YOU HAVE SOMETHING HERE,
but it’s just not polished at ALL!

Here is the GOOD:

1. The idea is CREATIVE AF and that first round with Margo is absolutely terrifying

Here is the BAD:

1. Margo and the gameplay become boring pretty fast

2. This game feels no different from the demo!
There are some new cutscenes, sure, but that’s about it

3. Randomized item locations are SO FRUSTRATING!
It’s not a game of skill, it’s a game of LUCK!!!

4. Opening drawers and cupboards ISN’T GAMEPLAY!!

Remove the randomizer PLEASE KEEP ITEMS IN SET LOCATIONS, ALWAYS THE SAME!!!
Make this damn game FREE or fix these problems, add new content that wasn’t in the demo, and then you can sell it!
